description: Compare N. crassa and S. cerevisiae histone H3 sequence context at candidate Rtt109 acetylation sites
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def usearch(q,fields="accession,id,protein_name,gene_names,length,organism_name",size=25):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
                   params={"query":q,"fields":fields,"format":"tsv","size":size},timeout=90); r.raise_for_status()
    L=[l.split("\t") for l in r.text.strip().split("\n")]
    return pd.DataFrame(L[1:],columns=L[0]) if len(L)>1 else pd.DataFrame()
def ufa(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60);r.raise_for_status()
    return "".join(r.text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

pd.set_option("display.width",260); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",70)
print("### N. crassa histone H3 entries ###")
print(usearch("(organism_id:367110) AND (protein_name:\"histone H3\")").to_string(index=False))

nc_h3 = ufa("P07041") if True else None
sc_h3 = ufa("P61830")   # yeast HHT1
print("\nN. crassa H3 (P07041), %d aa:" % len(nc_h3)); print(nc_h3)
print("S. cerevisiae H3 (P61830), %d aa:" % len(sc_h3)); print(sc_h3)

# UniProt histone numbering convention: mature numbering omits the initiator Met
def ctx(seq, k, flank=6, offset=1):
    """k = conventional histone position (A1 R2 T3 K4 ...), seq includes initiator Met => index k+offset-1"""
    i = k + offset - 1
    return seq[max(0,i-flank):i], seq[i], seq[i+1:i+1+flank]

print("\n--- check numbering: residue at conventional K4/K9/K14/K18/K23/K27/K36/K56 ---")
sites=[4,9,14,18,23,27,36,56]
rows=[]
for k in sites:
    a=ctx(nc_h3,k); b=ctx(sc_h3,k)
    rows.append(dict(site=f"K{k}",
                     Ncrassa_context=f"{a[0]}[{a[1]}]{a[2]}",
                     Scerevisiae_context=f"{b[0]}[{b[1]}]{b[2]}",
                     identical_context = (a[0]+a[1]+a[2])==(b[0]+b[1]+b[2])))
t=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(t.to_string(index=False))

# global identity of the two H3s
ident=sum(1 for x,y in zip(nc_h3,sc_h3) if x==y)
print(f"\nH3 N. crassa vs S. cerevisiae (ungapped, both {len(nc_h3)}/{len(sc_h3)} aa): {ident} identities = {100*ident/min(len(nc_h3),len(sc_h3)):.1f}%")
print("positions that differ:", [ (i+1, x, y) for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(nc_h3,sc_h3)) if x!=y ])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.4))
ys=[1]*len(sites)
ax.axis('off')
ax.text(0.01,0.93,"Acetylatable H3 lysines: sequence context in N. crassa vs S. cerevisiae",fontsize=11,transform=ax.transAxes)
for i,r in t.iterrows():
    ax.text(0.01,0.80-0.095*i,f"{r['site']:>4}  Nc {r['Ncrassa_context']:<16}  Sc {r['Scerevisiae_context']:<16}  "
            f"{'identical' if r['identical_context'] else 'DIFFERS'}",
            family="monospace",fontsize=9,transform=ax.transAxes,
            color="#1b7837" if r['identical_context'] else "#b2182b")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
